parsed_plan_sample.goal_summary: Verify that the target file is readable by performing a single read-only inspection and confirming its contents can be loaded without error.

steps.title: Verify file readability
steps.description: Open the target file in read-only mode, read its contents (or a small header sample), and confirm the operation succeeds without permission, encoding, or I/O errors. Record the observed byte size and a short content preview as evidence.
steps.expected_outcome: A success report confirming the file was opened and read successfully, including the observed byte size and a content preview, with no exceptions raised.

parsed_plan_sample.fallback_strategy: If the read fails, do not modify the file. Capture the exact error (e.g., ENOENT, EACCES, encoding failure), re-check the path and permissions with a read-only directory listing, retry once on a transient I/O error, and if it still fails, report the failure with diagnostics and request clarification from the orchestrator.
